gloss: the entire sky; the whole sky; across the sky

definitions.gloss: the entire sky; the whole sky; all across the sky
definitions.explanation: Describes the sky in its entirety, typically when it is completely covered or filled by something — clouds, stars, a sunset glow, etc.

examples.japanese: {空一面|そらいちめん}に{雲|くも}が{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: Clouds spread across the entire sky.

examples.japanese: {夕焼|ゆうや}けが{空一面|そらいちめん}を{赤|あか}く{染|そ}めた。
examples.english: The sunset dyed the entire sky red.

examples.japanese: {空一面|そらいちめん}に{星|ほし}が{輝|かがや}いていて、{息|いき}を{飲|の}むほど{美|うつく}しかった。
examples.english: Stars were shining across the entire sky, so beautiful it took my breath away.

notes:
A compound of {空|そら} (sky) and {一面|いちめん} (the whole surface, all over). Paints a picture of the sky as a single vast expanse uniformly covered or filled by something. Common in literary and descriptive writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空一面|そらいちめん}に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread across the whole sky
- {空一面|そらいちめん}を{覆|おお}う: to cover the entire sky
- {空一面|そらいちめん}の{雲|くも}: clouds across the whole sky
- {空一面|そらいちめん}が{灰色|はいいろ}になる: the entire sky turns gray

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一面|いちめん}の{雪|ゆき}: snow covering everything — {一面|いちめん} can be combined with other surfaces too
- {見渡|みわた}す{限|かぎ}りの{空|そら}: as far as the eye can see across the sky

USAGE:
The pattern ～{一面|いちめん} is productive and can be applied to other surfaces: {海一面|うみいちめん} (the entire sea), {野原一面|のはらいちめん} (across the whole field). It always conveys the image of something stretching uniformly over the entire area.
